description: This file defines the RetrieveStatisticsDetailsResponse class, a final, immutable Java class that extends AbstractDevOpsCommandResponse. It represents the response to a RetrieveStatisticsDetails command, encapsulating a JSON object with statistics details, and includes methods for creating instances from JSON strings or objects, as well as for serializing the response back to JSON.
